about: Per-character motion data for the frame-by-frame sheets: archetype, run class, signature (what the character holds and how each skill should look), timing and engine overrides, and the per-character mannequin overrides the PC applies to the archetype's base sequence. Copied into manifest sheet.motion at registration; the engine reads only the manifest. Frame bible: tools/art/specs/motion_bible.json. Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-26_motion_frames.md. Check: node tools/art/requests.js --motion. Hit weight: the hit table below (one source for every sheet).

status_values.pilot: in the pilot: mannequin + GPT strips + PC in-betweens + engine
status_values.gate1-mannequin: pilot gate 1 only: mannequin sequence, no GPT strip yet (tests the guide-similarity check or the release/origin path and the tightest budget)
status_values.decided-signature: owner decision recorded; timing / engine / mannequin come when the redraw is scheduled

hit.about: THE one source of the hit weight (heavy | mid | light) of every sheet listed here; registration copies it into manifest sheet.motion. The request generators keep a copy (tools/art/handoff.py CHARS hit_weight, tools/art/specs/captains_batch2.json hit_weight) and node tools/art/requests.js --motion FAILs when a copy differs or a generator sheet is missing here. motion_bible.json hit.weights.*.users and archetypes.*.hit_default are defaults only, for sheets not listed here. Resolved 2026-11-26 (verifier finding 5): every generator weight checked against the motion audit; where the audit gives a reason it is in 'why' (all agree with the generator), otherwise the generator's value is kept.

why.sheet/captain/ironwall: audit: absorbs the blow behind the shield and keeps her footing
why.sheet/captain/saintknight: audit: braces in her armour and barely gives ground (the healer default would be light)
why.sheet/captain/khan: audit: absorbs it without giving ground (the bow default would be light)
why.sheet/captain/frostjarl: audit: a braced flinch, feet not leaving the ground
why.sheet/captain/liberator: audit: takes it on the raised forearms and shackles, does not flinch
why.sheet/captain/pirateking: audit: staggers back and grimaces (the sword_shield default would be mid)
why.sheet/captain/lightbearer: audit: sways back, feet staying down
why.sheet/captain/inquisitorlord: audit: a small, contemptuous recoil - not light; generator mid kept
why.sheet/hero/marisol: pilot data (owner decision d2a73c2 entry); no generator package yet
why.others: the audit gives no hit reason: the generator's value is kept (class cleric, fieldmedic, pilgrim mid although the healer default is light; demonhunter, siegemaster, admiral mid although staff / gun default light; dragonslayer mid although greatweapon default heavy; bard and 산적 light although sword / sword_shield default mid)

mannequin_convention.set: <motion>__<sheet stem without 'sheet_'>, motion = atk | hit | idle, e.g. atk__class_warrior, atk__captain_shadowqueen, atk__captain_ironwall, atk__class_archer, hit__class_warrior, hit__captain_shadowqueen, idle__class_warrior. Request: art/requests/guides/<set>/README.md (+ optional start files; the cloud bakes no per-set draft). Delivery: art-inbox art/inbox/guides/<set>/<set>.aseprite ONLY - 384x1024 frames in world coordinates (sole line y=870, the planted foot stays put, the hip moves; an idle set's rest frame stands on hip x=192), layers Background, arm_far, leg_far, leg_near, torso, head, arm_near, optional weapon_back / weapon_front / shield (cloth_back / cloth_front), hidden joints (art/requests/guides/SPEC.md section 4); one Aseprite frame per sequence frame in the bible order, frame durations = the bible ms (with this character's timing.ms), one frame tag named after the motion (attack | hit | idle) over all frames (optional per-frame tags named after bible frames must sit on their frame).
mannequin_convention.frame_files: the cloud exports one PNG per frame from the delivered .aseprite (check_skeleton.py --export DIR): f<NN>_<name>.png, NN = 0-based index in the bible order, two digits, name with non-alphanumerics as '_' (sword_shield attack = f00_in, f01_hold, f02_swing, f03_contact, f04_follow, f05_recover, f06_settle; mid hit = f00_K1_impact .. f03_K4_settle), plus <set>_preview.gif and pose_measured.json. The PC delivers no PNGs.
mannequin_convention.check: python3 tools/art/check_skeleton.py <set>.aseprite --motion <attack|hit|idle> --set <set id> - the PC runs it before delivering, the cloud on intake; it reads motion_bible.json + this file (frame names, ms, contact / hold / cut, checks_by_kind, hit weight, pivot_foot). Rules and numbers: art/requests/guides/SPEC.md section 10.
mannequin_convention.overrides: absolute targets in head units for the named frames (posekit conventions, motion_bible.json units). Keys: hip [x, h], lean (rad), tilt (rad), footN / footF [x, h], grip_near / grip_far [x, h] (at() convention, shoulder line 2.40), wa (deg), shield [x, h], note. Frames not named follow the base set.
mannequin_convention.similarity: requests.js --motion FAILs when two characters with the same base set carry identical (or no) hold / contact overrides, and - once the PNGs exist - when their hold or contact frames reach alpha IoU > 0.8 at game size.

sheet/class/warrior.name: 일반 병과 전사

signature.explain: 같은 시트를 쓰는 성전사(성전의 철퇴)도 칼과 방패로 그린다 - 병과 시트는 계열 전체가 함께 쓴다(js/art.js sheetFor)
signature.basic: 방패 치기 = 방패 뒤로 웅크렸다가(준비 멈춤) 어깨를 넣어 방패를 얼굴 높이로 밀어 치고(휘두름 중간), 칼이 방패 가장자리 아래로 낮게 베며 맞는다(맞는 순간)
signature.special: 돌격(GENERIC_SPECIAL, 돌진 + 기절) = 기존 돌진 잔상 뒤 같은 공격 흐름. 승급 계열의 천검(2명)도 맞는 순간 프레임은 하나
signature.idle: 방패는 가슴 높이, 칼은 낮게 옆으로, 발은 어깨너비(무기를 보여 주는 넓은 웅크림이 아닌 자연스러운 경계 자세)
signature.hit_face: 면갑이 얼굴을 가려 표정은 보이지 않는다. 실루엣으로 읽힘: 머리가 방패 뒤로 숙고 어깨가 밀렸다 돌아온다

design_choice.question: 이 시트는 전사(방패 치기)뿐 아니라 성기사(심판의 방패)·수호기사(불굴의 성벽)와 검성(일섬)·검신(천검)·광전사(피의 난무), 성전사(성전의 철퇴)도 쓴다 (js/art.js sheetFor: 상급·최상급 시트가 없으면 기본 직업 시트).
design_choice.chosen: shield check, then sword cut: 휘두름 중간 = 방패 치기, 맞는 순간 = 방패 가장자리 아래로 칼이 낮게 벤다(방패는 앞에 그대로). 방패 기술은 휘두름 중간 → 맞는 순간에서, 칼 기술은 맞는 순간 → 지나침에서 읽힌다.
design_choice.why: 가장 많이 보이는 몸(화면 시간 17.6%)이라 한쪽만 맞추면 다른 갈래 대원이 모두 틀린 동작을 한다. 두 박자를 한 흐름에 넣으면 새 동작 종류 없이 둘 다 읽힌다.
design_choice.owner_veto: 주인이 '방패만' 또는 '칼만'을 원하면 이 행과 mannequin.overrides 만 고친다

engine.dx_note: game px at sheet scale 1; the engine multiplies by sheetK (S10)

돌격.note: dash ghosts use run cells once the sheet has anims.run

mannequin.pivot_foot: rear (footN) planted in every frame +-3 src px
mannequin.grip: sword in the near hand - low behind the hip at the hold with the blade raised up-back, dropped back-down at the swing, cutting low-forward at the contact; round shield on the far forearm, elbow ~90 deg

hold.note: weight back behind the raised round shield (head behind the feet's mid-point), sword hand low behind the hip, blade raised up-back clear of the body (README atk__class_warrior 2026-11-26e)

swing.note: SHIELD CHECK: shield punched forward at face height with the shoulder behind it, sword dropped back-down and trailing; pivot heel may lift (toe stays)

contact.note: sword cuts low-forward under the shield's lower edge (crosses its strike line), shield still forward, head ahead of the feet

follow.note: sword 30 deg past the strike line, rising forward

S2: idle rest (existing idle if natural, else redrawn)
strips.order: S1 -> S2 -> (runStride fixed with the run job) -> S3 -> S4, one strip per delivery

identity_refs: tint keys (class sheets keep the 7 key colours, ratio >= 0.04)

signature.basic: 밤의 칼날 = 두 칼을 어깨 뒤로 X자로 감았다가 낮게 숙이며 가위처럼 닫아 벤다(맞는 순간 = 가위가 닫힌 프레임 하나)
signature.special: 그림자 난무 = 돌진 후 가위 베기 한 번. 판정은 한 틱이라 맞는 순간 프레임도 하나이고, 피해자 반응과 베기 효과가 50ms씩 차례로 이어진다
signature.idle: 두 칼 아래로, 먼 칼은 몸 뒤 (승인된 대기 e4df48d)
signature.hit_face: 이를 악문다; 두건 아래 턱과 어깨가 비틀리는 실루엣이 먼저

accepted_cells.rest: registered cell 0 (idle, e4df48d - both blades down)
accepted_cells.swing: registered cell 5 (low scissor strike, 0cc6046 strip #3) - reused as the breakdown (S5)

engine.dx_note: game px at sheet scale 1; the engine multiplies by sheetK (S10)

그림자 난무.dash: lead frames play at the pre-dash spot; the dash ghost streak covers the swing frame; contact lands on the event tick at the new spot
그림자 난무.stagger_source: the same constant as the slash fx (js/battle.js view.slashes t: -i * 0.05): victim i reacts i x 50 ms after the contact frame; HP bars drop together on the sim tick
그림자 난무.basic_after_special: a basic can fire on the next tick (50 ms later; step runs the special, then basic.left). The basic wins: its contact frame (unpredicted, so it starts at contact) replaces the special's follow / recover; the special's slashes and victim staggers keep running because they are fx, not body frames. Every HP change keeps a contact frame on its tick.
그림자 난무.done_when: with 1 and with 4 targets the HP change and the contact frame fall on the same tick

mannequin.fit_to_accepted: the PC measures hip x/height and the planted foot on the accepted source strips (art/inbox/sheet_captain_shadowqueen.png on art-inbox: idle e4df48d, X wind-up aa0687e #2, strike 0cc6046 #3) and builds the mannequin so that its rest / hold / swing frames overlay those cells; new frames (in, contact, follow, recover, settle) continue from them
mannequin.pivot_foot: front (footF) from the swing frame on - as in the accepted strike; rear before
mannequin.grip: a blade in each hand, forward grip; X crossing at one point only (as accepted)

hold.note: X crossed above the head (one crossing point), upright and leaning back 6 deg so the head is behind the feet; stance ~1.76 head as in the accepted cell (x: idle hip column = 0, README x - 0.48; wa_far = the far blade)

swing.note: front foot steps +0.20 and becomes the pivot; blades come down forward

contact.note: scissor closed: lowest hip, hands reached out in front of the chest, the upper (far) blade coming down and the lower (near) blade coming up meet tip to tip in front of the front foot; both blades >= 60% clear of the body

follow.note: blades pass each other, 30 deg past each; the rear foot starts to drag in

S2: hit K3 recover (GPT version, compared with the warrior's PC K3)
strips.order: S1 -> S2 -> (runStride fixed) -> S3 -> S4, one strip per delivery

sheet/captain/ironwall.name: 브리긴다 (철벽 수호자)
sheet/captain/ironwall.why_in_pilot: second sword_shield character (C4): the hardest case for the similarity check because her basic is also a shield move. Mannequin only, no GPT strip in the pilot.

signature.basic: 방패 밀치기 = 어깨를 탑 방패에 넣고 웅크렸다가 몸 전체로 방패를 얼굴 높이까지 밀어붙인다. 철퇴는 머리 위로 들지 않고 방패 뒤에서 낮게 겨눈 위협으로 남는다
signature.special: 철벽 방진(rally) = 준비 멈춤 프레임(방패를 땅에 박은 자세)을 0.45초 유지 + 기존 고리 효과
signature.idle: 방패 뒤로 웅크림, 철퇴는 방패 테 위에 얹음, 숨쉬기는 아주 작게(무거운 갑옷)
signature.hit_face: 방패 뒤에서 이를 악물고 버틴다; 발은 움직이지 않는다

mannequin.pivot_foot: rear (footN); the front foot steps +0.15 head on contact
mannequin.grip: mace in the near hand, kept cocked behind; tall tower shield on the far arm, its lower rim >= 100 src px above the floor

hold.note: deep crouch with the shoulder dropped into the tower shield, weight back (head behind the feet's mid-point); mace cocked back at head height, not overhead (README atk__captain_ironwall 2026-11-26e)

swing.note: body uncoils, shield starts forward, front foot slides; mace unchanged

contact.note: SHIELD SHOVE: the whole body drives the shield face to its furthest reach at face height, front foot steps +0.15; the mace keeps its angle (140 deg hold to follow - a shove, not a cut)

follow.note: shield rebounds 0.25 head and dips, hip carries on +0.04

sheet/class/archer.name: 일반 병과 궁수
sheet/class/archer.why_in_pilot: bow mannequin for gate 1 (critique coverage gap): the release/origin path, the weakest-reading contact, and the tightest budget in the roster (대륙 순찰자 질풍 사격 cd 0.6 -> 510 ms). Mannequin only, no GPT strip in the pilot.

signature.explain: 화살통은 등에 멘다; nock 프레임에서 손만 닿는다. 같은 시트를 쓰는 노궁 대장(관통 노궁)도 활로 그린다 - 병과 시트는 계열 전체가 함께 쓴다
signature.basic: 조준 사격 = 꼿꼿이 서서 볼까지 당기고 멈춘 뒤, 놓는 순간 시위 손이 뒤로 크게 튄다(놓기 = 판정 프레임, 화살은 활 손의 원점 표시에서 나간다)
signature.special: 일제 사격(GENERIC_SPECIAL, 3명) = 놓기 한 번 + 부채꼴 효과. 질풍 사격 계열은 줄어드는 프레임으로 510ms 안에 든다
signature.idle: 활은 옆구리 아래로 낮게, 시위는 느슨하게, 발은 어깨너비
signature.hit_face: 후드와 천 마스크로 얼굴이 가려진다; 어깨가 비틀리고 머리가 밀리는 실루엣으로 읽힌다

engine.origin: arrow rest on the bow hand (marks layer)

mannequin.grip: bow in the far hand, arm straight at full draw; string hand near

hold.note: full draw to the cheek, upright (SPEC cross-check 1 #7)

release.note: string hand flies back >= 60 src px (0.55 head) from the hold; origin mark on the arrow rest

sheet/captain/liberator.name: 카토 (해방 검투사)
sheet/captain/liberator.decision: 주인 결정 11-26 (d2a73c2, art/requests/feedback.md): 사슬과 주먹으로 싸운다, 장검은 초상화처럼 등에. 다시 그리기는 프레임 방식으로.

signature.explain: 장검은 초상화처럼 등에 멘 채 쓰지 않는다 - 주인 결정 11-26 (d2a73c2)
signature.basic: 사슬 휘두르기 = 권투 자세에서 사슬을 몸 뒤 위로 채찍처럼 감았다가, 가슴 높이로 몸 앞을 가로지르는 가로 채찍(범위 8로 읽힘)
signature.special: 족쇄 부수기 = 같은 흐름에 멈춤이 센 내려찍기 + 기존 지진 효과
signature.idle: 낮은 권투 자세, 족쇄 찬 두 주먹을 올림, 가까운 손목에 굵은 고리 4~5개 사슬
signature.hit_face: 팔뚝과 족쇄로 받아내며 이를 악문다; 거의 흔들리지 않는다

sheet/hero/marisol.name: 마리솔 (해적 선장)
sheet/hero/marisol.decision: 주인 결정 11-26 (d2a73c2): 권총을 손에(두 스킬이 권총 사격·포격 지원), 활은 등에 멘 소품. 대사는 그대로.

signature.explain: 리커브 활과 화살통은 등에 멘 소품이다(쏘지 않는다) - 주인 결정 11-26 (d2a73c2); 대사 '남은 건 이 활 한 자루뿐이야'는 그대로 둔다
signature.basic: 권총 사격 = 몸을 옆으로 돌려 팔을 곧게 뻗어 조준, 한 손 사격, 반동으로 팔이 튀어 오르고 어깨가 젖혀지며 코트 자락이 흔들린다
signature.special: 포격 지원 = 같은 반동 자세가 포격 신호로 읽힘(엔진: 화면 밖에서 포탄이 떨어짐)
signature.idle: 한쪽 엉덩이에 무게, 권총은 어깨 옆에 총구를 위로, 빈손은 허리띠에
signature.hit_face: 모자가 비뚤어지고 찡그린다; 권총 든 팔이 바깥으로 벌어지는 실루엣

sheet/captain/beastmaster.name: 오르가 (야수 조련사)
sheet/captain/beastmaster.decision: 주인 결정 11-26 (d2a73c2): 특기 「늑대 떼 돌격」에서 본인은 제자리에서 명령, 엔진이 들늑대 2~3마리를 달려가게 그린다(전투 계산은 그대로).

signature.explain: 화살통은 등에 멘다. 회색 늑대는 손에 드는 것이 아니라 특기 때 엔진이 들늑대 시트(sheet/monster/들늑대, 우리 그림)로 2~3마리를 달리게 그린다 - 주인 결정 11-26 (d2a73c2)
signature.basic: 조련사의 활 = 나린보다 무겁고 천천히 당겨 짧고 날카롭게 놓는다
signature.special: 늑대 떼 돌격 = 본인은 돌진하지 않고 타격(놓기) 자세의 팔을 앞으로 뻗어 무리에게 명령, 들늑대 2~3마리가 대상에게 달려간다
signature.idle: 모피 망토, 활은 낮게, 빈손은 옆에 펴서 늘어뜨림(무리에게 보내는 신호처럼)
signature.hit_face: 찡그리며 어깨로 받는다; 모피 망토가 한 박자 늦게 흔들린다

늑대 떼 돌격.note: owner decision d2a73c2: she does not charge - she stays where she stands and commands with the release pose (bow arm thrown forward); the engine draws 2-3 grey wolves from the 들늑대 sheet running to the target (drawing only). The sim is unchanged: js/classes.js keeps hits 3 and dash, and the sim still moves her (js/battle.js useSkill dash) - how the view shows that move is the engine job's to settle. Not the generic multi-target melee (one contact frame + 50 ms victim stagger).
